book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Hara Asa Bolla Pirdanaas Koshshenna
«Intte bolla pirdettontta mala hara asa bolla pirdofte.
Intte pirdida mala intte bollaka pirdettana. Intte makkida miishshara inttes makettana.
Ne ayfen diza gita miththaa be7ontta dashe ne isha ayfen diza qeeri buura aazas xeellay?
Ne ayfen gita miththi dishin ne isha, ‹Ane ta ne ayfeppe qeeri buurayo kessays› gaanaas waana dandayay?
Nenoo qoodheppe qommon hanizaysso kasetada ne ayfen diza gita miththaa kessaycha. Hessafe guye ne isha ayfen diza buuraa kessanaas lo7eththa xeellandassa.
Ba tohon yedhdhontta malanne simmidi inttena saxxi daakereththontta mala anjjettidayssa kanata sinththan yeggofte; qasse intte worqqaaka guddunthata sinththan yeggofte.
Woossite, Koyite, Qoxxite
«Woossite inttes imettana; koyite intte demmana; kare qoxxite inttes doyettana.
Woossida ubbaas imettana; koyza asi demmana; qoxxizaades karey doyettana.
Intte giddofe issaades nay uketh woossiko shuch immiza aaway daandee?
Woykko mole woossiko shoosh immizaadey daandee?
Histtiin intte iitata gidi uttidi intte naytas lo7o miish imo erizayta gidikko intte salo Aaway iza woossizaytas waanidi aadhdhiza lo7o miish immennee?
Hessa gishshas hara asi inttes ooththana mala intte koyzayssa, intteka haratas ooththite. Muse wogaynne nabeti gizayssi hayssa.
Aaho Pengenne Xunththa Penge
«Xunththa pengera gelite; dhayoso efiza ogey gita; pengeyka aaho; daro asay he pengezara gelees.
De7os gaththiza ogey gidikko xunththa; pengeyka xunththa; gelanaytikka guuththata xalla.
Wordo Nabeta
«Isttas giddo baggay Kana suyte
mala gidi uttidinne dorsa ite may7i gelidi intte giddo giddon ooththiza wordo nabetappe naagettite.
Intte istta, istta ooson erandeta. Agunththa worappe woyney, kindichcho agunththafe balase ayfey maxettizee?
Hessaththoka lo7o miththi wuri lo7o ayfees; iita miththika iita ayfe ayfees.
Lo7o miththi iita ayfe ayfanaas dandayonttayssa mala iita miththi lo7o ayfe ayfanaas dandayenna.
Lo7o ayfe ayfontta miththi wurikka qanxxettananne taman yegettana.
Hessa gishshas intte istta istti ayfiza ayfen shaakki erana.
«Salon diza ta Aawaa shene polontta dishe tana, ‹Godoo! Godoo!› gizay wuri Salo Kawoteth gelenna.
He gallas daroti, ‹Godoo! Godoo! Nuni ne sunththan tinbite yootibeekkonii? Ne sunththan daydanth kessibeekkonii? Ne sunththan daro malaata ooththibeekkonii?› gaana.
He wode ta isttas, ‹Ta inttena mulekka erikke! Intte iitati taappe haakkite› gaada qonccera ta isttas yootana.
Keeththe Keexxiza Eranne Eeya Asa Leemiso
«Histtiko hayssa ta qaalaa siyidi ooson peyshizaadey ba keeththe zaalla bolla keexxizaade misatees.
Deexo iray bukkiin haroykka harottides; carkoyka carkides; keeththaaka sugides shin zaalla bolla keexettida gishshas kundibeenna.
«Hayssa ta qaalaa siyidi ooththonttaadey gidikko ba keeththe ace bolla keexxida eeya asa mala.
Deexo iray bukkiin haroykka harottides; carkoyka carkides; he keeththaaka sugides; keeththayka iita kundeth kundides» gides.
Yesusi tamaarsi wursiin asay iza timirtezan malalettides.
Gaasoykka Muse woga tamaarsizayta mala gidontta izi godateththi diza asa mala tamaarsides.

footnotes.text: Kana suyte: Kana suytey issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan suudhume geetettees.
